title: Article 92 — The Chairman or the Deputy Chairman not to preside while a resolution for his removal from office is under consideration

content.overview: Article 92 provides that the Chairman (Vice-President) or Deputy Chairman shall not preside while a resolution for his removal from office is under consideration. The Chairman has the right to speak and take part in proceedings of the Council while such a resolution is under consideration, but shall not vote at all on such resolution or on any other matter during such proceedings (except a casting vote in limited residual situations as the text provides for other contexts).
content.glance: Chairman/Deputy Chairman shall not preside during consideration of a resolution for his own removal.
content.study:
Article 92 ensures that the person whose removal is under consideration does not preside over those proceedings. Related removal of the Vice-President is under Article 67; Deputy Chairman under Article 90.

Examination: no self-presiding on removal resolution; participation rights as provided in the article.

sections.heading: Key rule
sections.body: While a resolution for removal of the Chairman or Deputy Chairman is under consideration, that person shall not preside.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Can the Chairman preside over a resolution for his own removal?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: No. Under Article 92, the Chairman or the Deputy Chairman shall not preside while a resolution for his removal from office is under consideration.

keyTakeaways: Art 92: Chairman/Deputy Chairman not to preside on own removal resolution.
